name: glycocart
description: Glucose-aware ordering agent for PCOS, prediabetes, and CGM users — built on Swiggy MCP

scripts.test:nutrition: tsc src/lib/nutrition-estimate.test.ts src/lib/nutrition-estimate.ts src/lib/catalog.ts --outDir .test-build --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && node .test-build/nutrition-estimate.test.js
scripts.test:profile: tsc src/lib/profile.test.ts src/lib/profile.ts --outDir .test-build --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && node .test-build/profile.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:nutrition && npm run test:profile && npm run test:contrast
scripts.test:contrast: tsc src/lib/contrast.test.ts --outDir .test-build --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && node .test-build/contrast.test.js
